Pattern.description: a named way of structuring an LLM application or agent

WorkflowPattern.description: a flow fixed by code: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer

AgentPattern.description: a loop in which the model decides: ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection

MultiAgentStructure.description: how several agents cooperate: supervisor, hierarchical team, handoff, pipeline, debate

Component.description: a building block of an agent: the agent loop, a tool, memory, a router, an evaluator

File.description: a source file or document, for example m03_patterns.py

Parameter.description: a setting or a limit, for example max_steps or LLM_TRACE

Concept.description: any other important idea; use it only when no other class fits

variant_of.description: A is a form or a variant of B

builds_on.description: A is built on, or reuses, B

implemented_in.description: A has runnable code in B

limited_by.description: A is bounded by the setting B
